gloss: sour grapes; poor loser attitude; excuses

definitions.explanation: Making excuses or disparaging something after failing to obtain it; refusing to accept defeat gracefully.

examples.japanese: ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{負|ま}け{惜|お}しみ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{聞|き}こえる→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧。

examples.english: Don't be a sore loser./Stop making excuses.

examples.japanese: {負|ま}け{惜|お}しみ⟦かもしれない→かもしれない：00164_kamoshirenai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}わなかった→合う：10466_au⟧。
examples.english: It might be sour grapes, but that job wasn't right for me.

examples.japanese: {負|ま}け{惜|お}しみ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{嫌|きら}われ→嫌う：02048_kirau⟧やすい。
examples.english: People who are sore losers tend to be disliked.

examples.japanese: 「⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{最初|さいしょ}→最初：00882_saisho⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{行|い}きたくなかった→行く：00119_iku⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{負|ま}け{惜|お}しみだろう。
examples.english: Saying "I never wanted to go to that university anyway" is probably just sour grapes.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{負|ま}け→負け：02569_make⟧ (defeat) + ⟦{惜|お}しむ→惜しむ：09610_oshimu⟧ (to regret, grudge) → regretting defeat = sour grapes

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {負|ま}け{惜|お}しみ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ - to make excuses after losing
- {負|ま}け{惜|お}しみ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{聞|き}こえる→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧ - to sound like sour grapes
- {負|ま}け{惜|お}しみ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧ - to be a bad loser

USAGE:
Used when someone refuses to accept failure gracefully and instead makes excuses or criticizes what they couldn't get. Similar to the English "sour grapes" from Aesop's fable.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {強|つよ}⟦がり→ガリ：27408_gari⟧ - putting on a brave face (hiding vulnerability)
- {負|ま}け{惜|お}しみ - sour grapes (making excuses for failure)
